adaptation_notes.registration: Separate no-alias G15 adapter in the maintained asahi module; retained failed probe and manual-unbind suppression. Existing normal/G17 paths kept.
adaptation_notes.drm: Uses target RegistrationData and current DRM/GEM/GPUVM APIs; no Uninit conversion or forged registered context.
adaptation_notes.mmio: G15 retained Mapping owns its register windows; target regs::Resources remains borrowed by RegistrationData.
adaptation_notes.sg_table: Target held_sg_table permanently pins backing and owns SG lifetime inside GEM; G15 HeldPages retains a GEM reference, not the removed owned-SG wrapper.
adaptation_notes.page_tables: Only adopted G15 page tables enable point-of-coherency publication; normal/G17 default remains false.
adaptation_notes.wire: Native per-device wire facade is separately supplied; canonical normal/G17 UAPI unchanged.
